text:
Rewrite the firstmate study's limit finding (studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json, shown in the 'Limits of this study' section that xtask/src/site.rs renders) in plain words: say that Athena did not run firstmate, so every claim comes from reading its files and no failure or retry was seen happening. Drop 'job', 'recorded boundary', 'edge' and 'marked read' from the reader-facing text, or define each one where it appears. Add a check in xtask/tests/site_page.rs that the rendered Limits section does not contain those internal terms undefined.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Study page 'Limits of this study' uses Athena-internal terms (recorded boundary, edge, marked read); newcomers can't tell firstmate was never run — flagged in ~31 audience ratings
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: studies/firstmate-work-handling/findings.json, xtask/src/site.rs, xtask/tests/site_page.rs
